title: Execute Compact around an actual selected complex child
body:
PR2483's actual selected-child return uses f=1, so its execution never reaches Compact. This adds a source-bound f=2 composition for actual selected child 7: both real monomial adapters with completed dirty-control repair, exact C^2, literal inverse and the existing parked caller return. The selected recipe acts on four of nine axes; the written factorization proves identity on the five spectator axes and avoids pretending the reduced finite payload enumerates the original eighteen-bit rectangle.

The independent direct operator checks all 512 native columns, both 512-column source monomials and all 256 reduced tensor columns. The physical replay executes all 12,288 records of its declared complete dirty/spectator domain, across three outer rows, and returns the active input, unequal inactive packets, scratch, heads and opaque ancestor exactly.

The main K=G=1 instance executes exceptional repair, but omitting it happens to preserve that small endpoint; this is recorded as a passing boundary control. A separate complete 2,048-record K=2 instance executes an actual selected right-adapter gate followed by C^2 and its inverse, and detects omitted repair. That case is one gate plus child, not the full selected child at K=2. Both are small all-exception fixtures, outside the asymptotic sparse-repair/long-record regime.

Validation:

- Python 3.12.7 registered package replay passed: full scientific receipt, seven rejecting controls, Git-free unchanged export, source rejection before import, typed complete receipt comparison, missing receipt and overwrite refusal.
- Python 3.14.5 optimized isolated scientific replay independently reproduced the complete receipt.
- Separate AI proof/code review found no blocker and independently reproduced the complete optimized receipt on Python 3.12.14; no independent human review claimed.
- Reproduce: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-child-compact-return`.

Exact sources and credit: PR2250 `d404b48a1e7b147556b309497d55089c837dddb2` and PR2287 `8c60765b5dea9d862b3b190d55da102a576031bf` by Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml supply the unchanged Compact/monomial and coefficient primitives; PR2483 `bf33528d17e1cb2c0398d7ee0eba7948acfed2dc` by ywz65 supplies literal parking and return. The retained original notices credit Douglas Colkitt, the compact/Clifford lineage and the Rohan Arun/Jeremy Kothe/Hao Yan selected supplier. This is their executed composition at one bounded interface, not a new Compact algorithm. Apache-2.0; substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in implementation, proof, checks, review and writing.
